'''Thavish''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] of the [[New Republic Fleet Intelligence|Fleet Intelligence]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
Born around [[34 BBY/Legends|34 BBY]], during the final [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], Thavish grew up where he served in the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] during the war against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="LSSM" />

Around [[5 ABY/Legends|5.5 ABY]], he served in the rank of [[Commander/Legends|commander]] as the intelligence coordinator of the [[Rapid Response Task Force]] commanded by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Kalback]]. Before the [[Battle of Mindor]], he gave a briefing to the [[Captain/Legends|captains]] of the task force, where he was ordered by [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] to be concise and not to use euphemisms when talking about people that suffer.
